summary: Clay County, AL tower completed 1949 on land of CC Twilley, who paid for it; dedication drew 600+. NHLR-registered 2010. Condition, staffing and access not documented.

events.note: Completed 1949 on land of CC Twilley, who also underwrote the cost; builder not named in the register
Dedication ceremony attended by more than 600 people, the largest crowd ever at the time for a lookout dedication (register)
Registered January 18, 2010 as US 867, AL 45; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

notes_for_editor: Lowest confidence of the three: only the NHLR register entry describes this tower. No source found for condition, current status, public access, staffing, fires, or who built it (the register lists the Forestry Commission only as administrator and cooperator). The record's 'standing' status is not confirmed by any source read. Searches returned mapping and topo-map pages (anyplaceamerica, mapcarta, itouchmap) that add nothing on the tower's history, and were not cited. The 1819 column is general statewide context and does not name this tower. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 4 page reads.
